1002431075.AnswerText:
A Bluetooth mouse connects directly to your laptop through Bluetooth (think of Bluetooth as being like WiFi but with less data being transmitted). A wireless mouse on the other hand will have a USB receiver which plugs into the USB port of your laptop - when you move your wireless mouse it will send this information wirelessly to the USB receiver which then sends this information to your laptop. 
Any wireless mouse or Bluetooth mouse will work with your laptop.

1003318675.AnswerText:
Hi there,

The LED indicator should only turn green for 10 seconds when the mouse is switched on or after deep-sleep mode recovery. It flashes red when battery power is low.
Try resolving the issue by re-inserting the battery, otherwise bring it in to your nearest store so a team member can inspect your unit and replace it if it is deemed faulty.

Regards,
RL

1003318623.AnswerText: Hi, When you turn on the mouse, the green LED will light up for about 10 seconds to indicate that the mouse is powered on.  If the battery is low, the green LED will start to flash red. This is to warn you that you need to replace the batteries soon. Otherwise, the LED will be off to conserve battery life. The Logitech M280 uses a sleep mode to save battery life, so the LED will only turn on when necessary.
